notes.title: Beta announcement
notes.notes:
Hello Gatewalkers!

Since 2020 comes to an end and now we are in 2021, we wish you all a happy new year! To start this new year with a blast, we want to announce the next phase of the Gatewalkers OPEN test!

Let us start by summing up June's ALPHA tests. We are thrilled and grateful to you, our players, for the great reception of Gatewalkers and helpful feedback. During the tests, around [b]80000 unique players[/b] played the game! This vast number of players and the overall positive rating of the ALPHA build (approximately [b]83% positive reviews[/b]) gives us a HUUUUGE  charge of positive energy to work further and improve Gatewalkers! THANK YOU!

Of course, we know that there is still a lot of work ahead of us. Some aspects of the game need to be refined and improved, but your opinions show us that we are heading in the right direction in general.

Now let us tell a little bit more about the upcoming tests.
 
The next open tests will take place during the upcoming STEAM Winter Festival ([b]starting from the 3rd of Feb, 2021[/b]). We have listened closely to your feedback, and we have prepared many changes to current mechanics (character customization, balance, progress tree, chargeable skills, etc.) and plan to show you some new ones (solo combos, conditional skills, remedies, etc.). 

Be aware, the Gatewalkers' upcoming open tests' goal is to hear your feedback about changes, new mechanics etc., without reviling too much story and content. Moreover, we have improved the graphics, UI, readability of some crucial aspects of the game, added expected background music, and more. 

We will post more detailed information about the next phase of tests in the upcoming weeks. 

As for current open tests, we are going to [b]close the servers of ALPHA on 08/01/2021 at 3:00 PM GMT[/b].

Also, as a new years resolution, we are going to inform you more systematically about the progress of Gatewalker's development.

Once again, thank you for being with us! 

Best wishes,
Gatewalkers Dev Team

PS. Your opinion is very important for us, so If you liked the game, please rate Gatewalkers ALPHA on Steam!

Remember to add main page to your wishlist:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1125710/Gatewalkers/

notes.title: Gatewalkers - Frequently Asked Questions
notes.notes:
[b]Gatewalkers - UPDATED Frequently Asked Questions[/b]

Greetings Gatewalkers! Here is the updated version of the answers to the most common questions. If you don't find the answer you're looking for here, go ahead and ask us whatever you want in the comments section.

[h1]What type of game is Gatewalkers?[/h1]
Gatewalkers is a cooperative action RPG and survival game, where players travel across different worlds in order to save their own. Explore procedurally generated worlds, face hostile inhabitants, face challenges like extreme weather conditions, toxic atmosphere, lack of water, and more.

[h1]When the game is going to be released?[/h1]
We are planning to release Gatewalkers on Q2/Q3 2021. The exact date of releasing the full version has not yet been established.

[h1]Do you already know the price of the game on the day of its release?[/h1]
It's a bit too early for that.

[h1]Will there be a single-player mode?[/h1]
Although the game is meant to be played in multiplayer, there will be a single-player mode available too. What is important to add, that the entire story can be played in both modes: solo and in cooperation.

[h1]How about local multiplayer mode?[/h1]
Currently, we are not working on local multiplayer mode. We are now focused on solo and online coop experience.

[h1]How many players can play together at once?[/h1]
In cooperation, you are able to play up to 4 players.

[h1]What are the system requirements for the game?[/h1]
It is still too early to tell you for sure, but we plan to optimize the game to allow players to enjoy the gameplay on most PCs (not just high-spec ones).

[h1]Are you planning to support XBOX/PS controllers?[/h1]
Yes, we are. Currently, we are working on adding the XBOX controller and PS4 controller.

[h1]Are you working on a Linux version?[/h1]
No. The game will be officially released on PC and Mac. However, we do not exclude support for gamers who want to run the game on Linux.

[h1]Are you planning to release Gatewalkers on consoles?[/h1]
Yes, we are! We are planning to support XBOX and PS consoles, but the porting will be done after the PC version release. The exact dates of the console release are still unknown.

[h1] Are there predefined levels in the game?[/h1]
No, we are procedurally generating the map at the start of each expedition.

[h1]Are you planning open/closed beta tests?[/h1]
Yes, we have done some tests and we are planning to make more of them till release.

[h1]How can I sign for the alpha/beta tests?[/h1]
The best way to join alpha/beta tests is to add Gatewalkers to your wishlist. Then you should see all information about upcoming tests and how to join them inside the Steam client.

[h1]Where is the right place to report the bug I have encounter during tests?[/h1]
The best place to do so is on our Discord server: https://discordapp.com/invite/8Tn76pT

[h1]Where can I follow the game development?[/h1]
The best place to follow the game development is at our social media:

Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/GatewalkersGame/
Twitter: @GatewalkersGame
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/gatewalkersgame/
Discord: https://discordapp.com/invite/8Tn76pT

[h1]Is the game going to have achievements and Steam cards?[/h1]
Yes. Both achievements and Steam cards are going to be implemented.

[h1]Are you looking for talents?[/h1]
We are always open to talented people so if you feel that you would be a good candidate for our team send as info to contact@a2softworks.com.

notes.title: Release Plan
notes.notes:
Dear Gatewalkers!

We have some news for you that we wish to share!

Our ALPHA test has started almost two months ago and for this time, you guys played a lot of games, killed a lot of enemies, and loot a huge number of secret chests. To sum up, around 55 000 unique players have played the game already and we've got VERY POSITIVE steam reviews on the GATEWALKERS ALPHA steam page. These numbers are great and we wish to thank you all for your time and feedback! Your constant support, positive and negative feedback gives us new energy to make the Gatewalkers better and better game. THANK YOU ALL ONCE AGAIN!

Based on that great experience during the alpha, and based on your feedback we come to the conclusion that the current way of doing staff is a way to go. In other words, we think that the best way to release the game is to make one or two more[b] free alpha/beta testes[/b] for you to check the game and for us to gather some more feedback and polish the game. As a result, of these tests, we wish to release the game in [b]Q2 2021[/b].

We hope you will like this plan and stay with us! We wish you all the best and have a great day!

Best regards,
Gatewalkers Dev Team

PS. Exact dates of future alpha/beta tests will be announced soon.

Remember to add Gatewalkers to you wishlist:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1125710/Gatewalkers/

notes.title: Alpha Patch #1
notes.notes:
Dear Gatewalkers,

We have uploaded a first big fix for the current alpha version of the game. Below you have more detail about them:

[list]
[*] fix of nickname issue, where players could not play because of their player's name on steam had illegal characters or is too short / too long. Now players can change the character name at the login screen.
[*] fix of problem where players had no starting equipment and empty storage chest
[*] fix of some login server issues
[*] fix of Surian Guardian Secret Chest. Now Surian forest secret box guardians are spawning correctly and this box drops appropriate reward
[*] fix of lack of gem to craft Stamina Ring. Now players can find Peridot gem in challenge boxes and secret boxes.
[*] fix of minor fixes of graphical glitches and minor stability issues
[/list]

We hope you are still enjoying playing Gatewalkers, and all players that were unable to play now will try the game!

Gatewalkers Dev Team
